gen-fs-nippo-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, its curves never clogging and its lowercase filling most of the letter height. Then Nippo steps in up top, wiry and technical, with small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals, so a long page stays easy going.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-cossette-texte: Wire-cut and technical, Nippo puts its near-capital small letters up front while Cossette Texte follows in a plain sans with a prominent x-height. Paragraphs move along without a snag.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-duru-sans: Nippo's letters look cut from wire, each glyph drawn with one tip, and its small letters stand almost as tall as capitals. Duru Sans below is wide-mouthed and modern, so try it a size or two under the heading.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-fresca: Fresca reads open and modern, its counters staying connected to the outside and its ascenders short above big bowls. Nippo's wire-like capitals-in-miniature give it a sharper, more technical edge overhead.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-funnel-sans: Professional through and through, Funnel Sans keeps its strokes steady. Nippo above it is the wirier, more technical voice, its small letters nearly capital height, while the sans-serif below stays composed and wide in the e.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-gafata: Gafata reads tall and open, with short stalks above a generous band of letters. Nippo, with no stroke contrast at all, lends it a wire-cut headline voice, and the two sit together like neighbors who agree on the essentials.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-geist: Geist reads quietly, in solid word blocks with no accents of weight. Its strongest quality is that stillness, which lets Nippo's wire-cut, near-capital small letters be the only loud thing in the pairing.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-georama: Nippo holds a steady, unvarying weight from word to word, its small letters nearly capital-sized. And Georama keeps to that mood in a friendly sans, with a wide-open c, so a long page stays easy to move through.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-gidole: Wire-cut and futuristic, Nippo's small letters stand almost capital-tall, and it earns its keep big and short. But Gidole stays tidy underneath, its terminals held apart like open scissor blades in a sans-serif of neon-tube consistency.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-golos-text: Technical wire lines, small letters standing proud: that is Nippo. Golos Text meets it with an x-height that fills the line and a widely parted s, which is the pair's strongest quality, a friendly sturdiness.
